text:
alyssa: Quick sync — we want a 2-week early-access drip for Launchpad webinar registrants. goal = get 30% to claim early preview + drive 150 product trial signups.

sam: love it. timeline? assets? audience segment?

alyssa: target = webinar registrants who attended or watched replay in past 90 days + new signups who opted into product updates. split into: high-intent (attended + opened onboarding email) and cold (registered, no opens).

maria: suggest different creative by segment. high-intent gets feature deep-dive + CTA to book demo. cold gets value teaser + social proof. keep copy < 3 lines for mobile.

jamal: tracking notes — please add UTM params: utm_campaign=launchpad_preview, utm_source=newsletter, utm_medium=email, utm_content={segment}. also add header for `X-Campaign-Stage` to route in CRM.

zara: can Sales Ops get nightly list of claimers? we should pipe claimers with score >= 60 to AE queue.

alyssa: yes. @zara can you confirm CRM mapping?

zara: confirming — mapping: preview_claim = Lead.Custom.Preview_Claimed (boolean), preview_score (int). night job at 2am PST will push accepted leads to `ae_queue_launchpad`.

sam: A/B subject lines to test: A) "Early access: Try Launchpad before general release" B) "Sneak peek: exclusive Launchpad preview for you". what cadence?

maria: cadence idea: day 0 claim invite, day 3 reminder, day 7 teaser video + social proof, day 10 last chance + stronger CTA. 4 sends total.

alyssa: schedule snippet (send windows):
```
Day 0: 9:30am PST (invite)
Day 3: 11:00am PST (reminder)
Day 7: 10:00am PST (teaser video)
Day 10: 8:30am PST (last chance)
```

jamal: analytics plan — funnel metrics: delivered -> opened -> clicked -> claim -> trial signup. aim: open 30% / click 8% / claim 4%. set cohort tagging by subject variant and segment.

sam: creatives needed: 2 subject variants, 2 preheaders, 2 hero images (web + mobile), 1 45s teaser video clip. who owns which?

maria: I'll do subject + preheaders + hero copy. cc @alyssa for voice. video — can we repurpose the product demo clip?

alyssa: design + ops: please confirm image sizes and alt text by EOD Thurs. zap to #launch-assets when ready.

zara: automation flow outline for ops: when user clicks "claim preview" -> tag preview_claim true -> email confirmation immediate with calendar link -> if claimers complete onboarding checklist -> webhook to Sales Ops. I'll drop the Flow JSON after this thread.

jamal: remote metric: if trial conversion dips vs benchmark, we pause day 7 and swap content to case study. set pause rule: conversion < 60% of baseline after 48h.

sam: gating note — do we gate preview by company size? small startups -> self-serve, enterprises -> sales handoff. segmenting on `company_size` field.

maria: copy tip: emphasize "limited seats" and "first-to-try" language for FOMO. avoid overpromising. short testimonial + logos in day 7.

alyssa: final checklist:
- [ ] assets in #launch-assets by Thu EOD
- [ ] CRM mapping confirmed (zara)
- [ ] UTMs in templates (jamal)
- [ ] AE nightly job active (zara)
- [ ] automation flow pushed (zara)
- [ ] analytics dashboard ready (jamal)

sam: i'll set up the A/B test in the ESP and create two send cohorts. will share the seed list and preview links.

launch-bot: Reminder: campaign send window set to 9:30am PST on 2024-04-05 for Day 0. Confirm assets 48h prior to send. :robot_face:

alyssa: thanks team — if we hit all checks by Thu, we go live on Mon. ping me for copy reviews.

maria: I'll post first drafts by Tue AM.

jamal: I'll prep the dashboard and baseline numbers by Wed.

zara: Ops will run a dry-run on Fri.

sam: awesome — moving this to the Launchpad project and tagging tasks. :thumbsup:
